frozen_mechanics.reason: The discovery point estimate was positive in both chronological halves but the interval was very wide and the family-wise adjusted p-value was one. Confirmatory evidence therefore begins under a new identity without changing the mechanism.

evaluation.multiple_testing: Correct across every H1-H51 strategy and discarded variant, not merely H43.
evaluation.promotion: No live path. Passing the mechanical read only triggers a separate implementation and risk review.
evaluation.null_outcome: Measured edge may be approximately zero; no parameter or inverse signal may be selected from the discovery cohort.
